description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class EmployeeDaoTest for testing the EmployeeDao class within the OrangeHRM application, specifically for the PIM module's data access operations related to employees.

classes.name: EmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for EmployeeDao class covering various employee data retrieval and manipulation methods, hierarchy validation, and email availability checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of EmployeeDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate employee IDs by supervisor ID with different flags.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate lists for a supervisor.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_Simple2LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Tests subordinate list retrieval in a simple two-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_3LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Tests subordinate list retrieval in a three-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Verifies if a given employee ID corresponds to a supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeIds
methods.description: Helper method to extract employee IDs from a list of Employee objects.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdList
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdListOneEmployee
methods.description: Tests the scenario where only one employee remains after deleting others.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployees
methods.description: Tests the deletion of employee records.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of supervisor IDs for a given subordinate.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Checks retrieval of an employee's work shift details.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee lists with various filters and sorting options.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers based on filtering parameters including subunit filters and sort fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of employees matching filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmailList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of email addresses for employees.

methods.name: testIsWorkEmailIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks the availability status of an employee's work email.
